Golden Harvest Intro: Unlock the power of planned savings with our Gold Purchase Plan — a smart, flexible way to invest in your dream jewellery.
TC 1 Body:
1.1 The TTJ Gold Purchase Plan is a smart way for customers to plan and accumulate funds systematically for the purchase of gold jewellery.
1.2 This Gold Purchase Plan is NOT a financial investment, deposit, chit fund, or security product. No interest or guaranteed returns are offered.
1.3 Amounts accumulated under this Plan can be redeemed only for jewellery purchases at TTJ stores.
TC 2 Body:
2.1 The Gold Purchase Plan is open to resident Indian individuals aged 18 years and above.
2.2 Valid KYC documents (PAN and Aadhar mandatory) are required at enrollment.
2.3 TTJ reserves the right to accept or reject any enrollment without assigning reasons.
TC 3 Body:
3.1 Plan duration shall be 11 months unless otherwise specified.
3.2 Customer shall Enroll from Rs.1000/- and in multiple of Rs 100/- thereafter. Customer can select the Gold Purchase Plan as per their requirement 1g onwards.
3.3 Customers are required to pay at least one monthly payment for every month to avoid loss of Gold Purchase Plan benefits.
3.4 Customers can make multiple payments during the duration of Gold Purchase Plan to achieve the selected gold purchase plan target.
3.5 Gold Purchase Plan ends on the 330th day from joining, with a 15-days window post maturity for redemption.
TC 4 Body:
4.1 Payments can be made via UPI, bank transfer, debit/credit card, or other modes approved by TTJ.
4.2 All payments are subject to successful receipt confirmation.
TC 5 Body:
5.1 Payments are converted in to 9kt gold rate based on the prevailing rates on the payment date.
5.2 Gold rates are determined by TTJ based on market conditions.
TC 6 Body:
6.1 On successful completion of Gold Purchase Plan duration, TTJ offers 15% Flat discount on the product value. (Gold, Diamond, Silver)
6.2 Benefits are non-transferable and not redeemable in cash.
TC 7 Body:
7.1 Redemption is allowed only after completion of the Gold Purchase Plan Duration.
7.2 Redemption must be completed within 15 days from Gold Purchase Plan end.
7.3 Redemption is permitted only against purchase of jewellery from TTJ Next Gen Jewels store.
7.4 Redemption request shall be submitted through the “Wardrobe” mobile application with authentication process to be followed.
7.5 Cash refunds are not permitted under normal circumstances.
TC 8 Body: 8.1 Customers are advised to keep their account details and mobile app credentials secure.
TC 9 Body:
9.1 Making charges, wastage, GST, and statutory taxes shall be borne by the Customer at the time of jewellery purchase.
9.2 Plan benefits apply only to gold value and not to taxes or additional charges.
TC 10 Body:
10.1 Gold prices are subject to market fluctuations.
10.2 TTJ does not guarantee protection against price increase or decrease.
10.3 Customer acknowledge and accept gold price volatility.
TC 11 Body:
11.1 PAN & Aadhar is mandatory for compliance with statutory regulations.
11.2 TTJ reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts for non-compliance.
TC 12 Body: 12.1 Customers will receive updates regarding their plan via SMS, Email, or App notifications.
TC 13 Body:
13.1 TTJ reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the Plan with prior notice.
13.2 Updates will be communicated via store notice, website, or direct communication.
TC 14 Body: 14.1 TTJ shall not be liable for losses arising from market conditions, regulatory changes, or force majeure events.
TC 15 Body:
15.1 These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of India.
15.2 Courts in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
TC 16 Body: By enrolling in the Gold Purchase Plan, the Customer confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.
